text:
Nadia (CS Ops): putting together a 'Tenant Stabilization Playbook' customers can run during onboarding and before renewals. Goal: pragmatic steps for caching, batching, streaming + how we capture feedback. Quick sanity check? (~5 min)
Rohit (Solutions Eng): love it. Can we make it action-first: 1) prefill & smoke 2) batching defaults 3) stream fallback 4) telemetry + consent 5) renewal triggers. Keep each item 1-2 lines.
Nadia (CS Ops): yep. drafts below. feel free to drop edits.
Marta (CS): i like the customer-facing checklist idea. add a tiny "who to ping" mapping for each tier (green -> CS rep, yellow -> enablement, red -> SRE).
Kara (SRE): ops notes: include safe backoff pseudocode and a cap on concurrent prefill threads. e.g., pseudocode: `sleep = min(base*(2**attempt) + rand(0,jitter), max_wait)`; max_attempts=6. Also: avoid scheduling tenant-wide prefill at boundary times (00:00/UTC).
Rohit (Solutions Eng): pasteable examples to include:
- curl prefill smoke (1-liner):
`curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"tenant":"TENANT_X","keys":["landing","faq"]}'`
- SDK batching JSON (one-line): `{"client":{"batch_window_ms":60,"max_tokens":1200}}`
Liam (PM): renewal alert thresholds to share with CS (slightly stricter):
- YELLOW: error_rate >= 1.5% for 24h OR p95 >= 1.7x SLO for 8h
- RED: error_rate >= 3% for 8h OR p95 >= 2x SLO for 4h OR failed prefill after a scheduled ramp
Map to actions: monitor -> schedule enablement (30m) -> war room + temporary model fallback.
Nadia (CS Ops): streaming guidance: recommend chunked streaming for interactive flows; fallback flow text: "stream -> resume up to 2 attempts -> if resume fails -> return cached snippet + enqueue full generation async (notify via webhook)". Also ask customers to surface `stream.resume.count` and `stream.disconnect.rate`.
Kara (SRE): cache tuning: suggest TTL bands by content churn: high=30-90m, medium=4-8h, static=7+ days. Include circuit-breaker rule: "if tenant causes >45% of cache evictions in 30m, quarantine shared cache for tenant and switch to per-tenant cache namespace". Do NOT recommend global unlimited cache.
Rohit (Solutions Eng): attach small DK (developer kit) snippets customers can paste into onboarding docs: backoff pseudocode, prefill curl, and SDK batching one-liner.
Marta (CS): feedback capture: include post-onboard 2-question survey + telemetry keys we ask for: `onboard.prefill.success_ratio`, `client.batch.window_ms`, `stream.resume.count`, `prefill.smoke.status`. Add a short email template to request telemetry consent.
Liam (PM): consent wording (short): "We request anonymized runtime metrics to help optimize your onboarding. Reply YES to opt-in; we will provide a short consent form." Add GDPR note: must get written opt-in for EEA customers.
Nadia (CS Ops): quick escalation ladder (customer-facing):
- GREEN: confirm warmpool + smoke OK -> no action
- YELLOW: schedule 30-min enablement + share dashboard link -> assume 48h follow-up
- RED: immediate triage -> SRE engage + consider temporary routing to smaller model variant to preserve customer UX
Rohit (Solutions Eng): small FAQ snippets to add: "p95 spike during ramp? -> check client batching window, prefill TTLs, and noisy tenant circuit-breaker"; "stream disconnects? -> check resume_attempts and network timeouts".
ConsentBot: consent template generated -> ID CONSENT-2334 -> link: https://consent.redwood.example/templates/telemetry-brief.txt
Nadia (CS Ops): awesome. i'll convert into a 2-page customer PDF (page 1: runbook, page 2: 1-line checklist + email templates) and drop it in #customer-success tomorrow AM for a final pass. tagging @Marta (CS) for the renewal wording. thanks all :thumbsup:
